lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as a series of quasi-linear vertical arrays of circular high-luminance pixel clusters. The primary array posterior to the branchial region consists of five distinct nodes, followed by multiple columns forming a non-perfect rectangular grid extending caudally.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance values intersect with the horizontal carinae and circular spot nodes to form a structural grid across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features are visible along the upper and mid-flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the upper edge and low intensity shadows immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible surface of the first dorsal fin displays a distribution of approximately 8-12 high-luminance blobs of varying diameters, primarily clustered towards the anterior and mid-sections of the fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct serrated irregularity and loss of tissue on the distal trailing edge of the left pectoral fin, indicating potential physical trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three distinct low-luminance elongated shapes (remoras) attached at the ventral boundary and near the pectoral fin insertion point.
